name: Heart burst
summary: A big heart pops in and bursts into many small hearts that drift outward and fade; for love, likes and thanks.

params.name: size
params.note: width of the big heart in px

params.name: burstAt
params.note: frame inside the shot when the heart bursts

params.name: at
params.note: start as a fraction of the shot (0..1)

params.name: atFrame
params.note: start frame inside the shot; overrides at

params.name: color
params.note: big heart colour; default the style accent

author: krakujs
